decisions.reason: The plug-in line extends the core data integration business at low marginal cost and has its own page, so it meets aspirations and gives no reason for problemistic search.
The delegation service overlaps with the Identity Service and could be folded into it, but it costs little to carry and the firm's slack lets it stay on the market for now.
The open GIS framework is central to the firm's strategy of open, extensible components and feeds its project business, so dropping it would undercut the core offer.
The Identity Service supports the strategic move toward integration with enterprise systems and was actively promoted, so it likely meets aspirations.
The consulting workshop was newly launched with its own page, uses existing expertise at low cost, and generates leads for project business, so it is too early to judge it as falling short.
